method: Full-field editorial translation with era-specific historical research; not an independent scholarly certification.

sourceExceptions.reason: Original appoint to most qualified read as appoint the most qualified; English unchanged.
Original should every right has missing have; interpreted as should have every right, not changed in English.
Ads and campaign effects retained as original simulated feedback, not independent certification of specific advertisements.
Michigan speech gaffe remains original narrative; exact speech incident not independently verified in this batch.

revisions.source: Opposing these actions places any candidate well outside of the American mainstream. We will attack Dukakis relentlessly on this point.
revisions.zh: 反对这些行动，会使任何候选人都远离美国社会的主流立场。我们将就此毫不留情地攻击杜卡基斯。

revisions.source: These were poorly thought out positions, and we will highlight that, but we should spend most of the campaign focusing on my own merits.
revisions.zh: 这些立场考虑不周，我们会突出这一点，但竞选的大部分时间还是应该强调我自己的长处。

revisions.source: Reasonable people can disagree on the merits of these actions. We don't have much to gain by bringing them into the campaign.
revisions.zh: 理性的人可以对这些行动是否妥当持不同意见。把它们带进竞选，对我们没有多少好处。

revisions.source: This is yet another example of Dukakis's poor judgment when it comes to defending American values.
revisions.zh: 这又一次说明，杜卡基斯在捍卫美国价值观方面判断失当。

revisions.source: I think we need to preserve a level of dignity in this campaign, and talking about things like sodomy and bestiality might be a little bit too far for some people.
revisions.zh: 我认为，这场竞选需要保持一定尊严，谈论鸡奸与兽交之类的事情，对某些人来说可能有些过头。

revisions.source: The ACLU may be popular on some northeastern college campuses, but in most of the U.S. this association should be a millstone. We will obviously highlight it.
revisions.zh: 美国公民自由联盟也许在东北部某些大学校园里很受欢迎，但在美国大多数地方，与它有联系应当是个沉重包袱。我们当然会突出这一点。

revisions.source: People have different opinions about the ACLU. I won't go into it too much on this campaign.
revisions.zh: 人们对美国公民自由联盟看法不同。这场竞选中，我不会多谈这个问题。

revisions.source: I was absolutely not involved with these dealings at any point, and I was appalled to find out about them.
revisions.zh: 我在任何时候都绝对没有参与这些交易，得知此事时，我十分震惊。

revisions.source: I should have been more aware that something was going on, based on some meetings I attended, and I regret not doing more to stop this at the time.
revisions.zh: 根据我参加过的一些会议，我本该更加留意到有事情正在发生。我后悔当时没有采取更多措施加以阻止。

revisions.source: Mr. Reagan's words are his own. I admire the President, but I would never go so far as to throw names at our opponent.
revisions.zh: 里根先生的话是他自己的意见。我敬重总统，但绝不会过分到用辱骂称呼攻击我们的对手。

revisions.source: Reagan himself admitted he was only trying to tell a joke, which came off poorly. I think we should move on to other issues.
revisions.zh: 里根自己承认，他只是想讲个笑话，结果效果很不好。我认为，我们应该转向其他议题。

revisions.source: We're proud to have Dan Quayle on the ticket, and he will be making important appearances in key swing states this fall.
revisions.zh: 我们很自豪能与丹·奎尔组成竞选搭档。今年秋天，他将到关键摇摆州参加重要活动。

revisions.source: The announcement of Quayle didn't go over quite like we wanted to. Let's have him campaign in safely Republican areas for the time being, until this furor subsides.
revisions.zh: 宣布奎尔人选后的反应，并不完全如我们所愿。目前先让他到共和党稳占优势的地区竞选，等这阵风波平息。

revisions.source: That's a ridiculous statement. Of course some partisan Democrats are making that case, but Mr. Quayle more than held his own.
revisions.zh: 这种说法荒唐透顶。当然，有些偏袒本党的民主党人会这样说，但奎尔先生的表现完全不落下风。

revisions.source: We will run a heavily biographical campaign this fall, including ads which highlight my military service.
revisions.zh: 今年秋天，我们将大力围绕我的个人经历开展竞选，包括突出我军旅经历的广告。

revisions.source: Obviously we'll mention this some, but our main focus will be on the here and now.
revisions.zh: 我们当然会有所提及，但主要还是着眼于当下。

revisions.source: We need to do anything necessary to reduce the staggering rate of murder and violent crime in this country.
revisions.zh: 我们必须采取一切必要措施，降低国内高得惊人的谋杀与暴力犯罪率。

revisions.source: I believe, if a state wishes to impose capital punishment, that it should have every right to do so.
revisions.zh: 我认为，如果一个州希望实行死刑，就应当完全有权这样做。

revisions.source: I believe that capital punishment is ineffective at reducing crime, and is not applied in an equal manner. I do not support the practice.
revisions.zh: 我认为，死刑不能有效减少犯罪，其适用也不平等。我不支持死刑。

revisions.source: As President, I will do anything I can to cut income taxes further.
revisions.zh: 作为总统，我会尽一切努力进一步削减所得税。

revisions.source: I hope that this isn't necessary, but it would be irresponsible to rule anything out at the present time.
revisions.zh: 我希望不必加税，但现在就排除任何可能性，是不负责任的。

revisions.source: I think we can take limited steps to bring this trade back into balance, but in general we should celebrate the expansion of world trade with our allies.
revisions.zh: 我认为，可以采取有限措施，使这项贸易恢复平衡。但总体而言，我们应该欢迎与盟友之间的世界贸易扩展。

revisions.source: Our first resort should be to negotiate with Japan and take steps to enhance the competitiveness of American industry. But I wouldn't take anything off the table.
revisions.zh: 我们的首选应是与日本谈判，并采取措施增强美国工业的竞争力。不过，我不会排除任何手段。

revisions.source: We have taken too many steps to expand world trade without adequately protecting American workers from the consequences. I would definitely run a more protectionist Administration.
revisions.zh: 我们为扩大世界贸易采取了太多措施，却没有充分保护美国工人免受其后果影响。我肯定会让政府采取更强的贸易保护政策。

revisions.source: I will definitely take someone's views on the rights of the unborn into account when making judicial appointments.
revisions.zh: 任命法官时，我肯定会考虑其对未出生者权利的观点。

revisions.source: There is a lot more to jurisprudence than someone's belief on a small aspect of the abortion issue. My goal will be to appoint to most qualified judges available.
revisions.zh: 法学远不止一个人对堕胎问题某个小方面的看法。我的目标是任命能找到的最合格法官。

revisions.source: It's only right to consider a judge's views on the right to choose when making appointments.
revisions.zh: 任命法官时，考虑其对选择堕胎权利的观点，才是正确做法。

revisions.source: This is getting it completely backwards. American families have every right to defend themselves from America's crime epidemic.
revisions.zh: 这完全是本末倒置。面对美国的犯罪浪潮，美国家庭完全有权保护自己。

revisions.source: I would only support limited steps on this issue, like a ban on “cop killer” bullets. Overall, I'm an opponent of increased gun control.
revisions.zh: 在这个问题上，我只会支持有限措施，例如禁止“杀警子弹”。总体而言，我反对加强枪支管制。

revisions.source: I believe that we need to consider any measure to reduce our nation's crime epidemic, including new gun control legislation.
revisions.zh: 我认为，为遏制全国的犯罪浪潮，我们需要考虑一切措施，包括新的枪支管制立法。

revisions.source: This program will be a centerpiece of our defense against the Soviet Union for many years to come.
revisions.zh: 这项计划将在未来许多年里成为我们防御苏联的核心。

revisions.source: We should be making every effort we can with this program, but if the Soviet Union were to offer sufficient concessions, it should certainly be a bargaining chip.
revisions.zh: 我们应该尽一切努力推进这项计划，但如果苏联愿意作出足够让步，它当然也可以成为谈判筹码。

revisions.source: We need to form a comprehensive energy strategy and re-implement price supports for domestic oil production.
revisions.zh: 我们需要制定全面的能源战略，并重新对国内石油生产实行价格支持。

revisions.source: I believe that American companies should every right to bid on foreign oil contracts with our allies.
revisions.zh: 我认为，美国企业应当完全有权竞标盟友的海外石油合同。

revisions.source: Cheap oil is an overall benefit to our economy. I think the majority of voters will understand that this fall.
revisions.zh: 廉价石油总体上有利于我们的经济。我认为，今年秋天多数选民都会理解这一点。

revisions.source: We need more funding for federal programs to mitigate the worst effects of this downturn.
revisions.zh: 我们需要为联邦项目增加拨款，以缓解这次衰退最严重的影响。

revisions.source: Unfortunately, the economics of farming cannot support the number of farmers who were borrowing money in the early 1980s.
revisions.zh: 遗憾的是，农业的经济条件无法维持20世纪80年代初举债经营的那么多农民。

revisions.source: We need to increase the support for American agriculture by fighting for exports in our trade deals -- with the Soviet Union, Mexico, and elsewhere.
revisions.zh: 我们需要在与苏联、墨西哥及其他地方达成贸易协议时争取出口，增强对美国农业的支持。

revisions.source: We could have stabilized this situation much earlier with aggressive intervention from the federal government. This is the type of thing I would have done if I were President.
revisions.zh: 如果联邦政府更早积极介入，我们本可以更早稳定局势。假如我是总统，这正是我会做的事。

revisions.source: The Midwest. Especially Illinois, Michigan, and Ohio.
revisions.zh: 中西部，尤其是伊利诺伊州、密歇根州和俄亥俄州。

revisions.source: Texas and its neighboring states.
revisions.zh: 得克萨斯州及其邻州。

revisions.source: New York, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania.
revisions.zh: 纽约州、新泽西州和宾夕法尼亚州。

revisions.source: I'd prefer to avoid that kind of thing if we can.
revisions.zh: 如果可以，我宁愿避免这类事情。

revisions.source: Let's do it.
revisions.zh: 那就辩论吧。

revisions.source: This is a mainstream position for a Republican to take.
revisions.zh: 这是共和党人通常会采取的主流立场。

revisions.source: This is a good theme which distinguishes your own brand from that of Reagan.
revisions.zh: 这是个不错的主题，能让你的政治形象与里根有所区别。

revisions.source: Reagan is popular, but people also want to see you distinguish yourself. There is an undertone of criticism that you lack influence, and that you don't stack up to Reagan.
revisions.zh: 里根很受欢迎，但人们也想看到你展现自己的特色。有些批评隐约认为，你缺乏影响力，也比不上里根。

revisions.source: Dukakis hammered on the “competence” theme in his speech. It is always good to fight back against that narrative.
revisions.zh: 杜卡基斯在演说中反复强调“治理能力”。对这种说辞予以反击，总是好的。

revisions.source: Many advisors believe that your only chance to come back against Dukakis is to go on the attack.
revisions.zh: 许多顾问认为，你逆转杜卡基斯优势的唯一机会，就是主动攻击。

revisions.source: This is definitely a passive answer for the situation you are currently facing.
revisions.zh: 面对你当前的处境，这个回答显然很被动。

revisions.source: You have staked out the conservative position on this issue.
revisions.zh: 你在这个问题上明确采取了保守派立场。

revisions.source: With the caveats added, this position can help finesse the issue among conservatives and moderates alike.
revisions.zh: 加上这些限定条件之后，这一立场能帮助你兼顾保守派与温和派，巧妙应对这个议题。

revisions.source: Observers are surprised at your relatively moderate stance.
revisions.zh: 观察人士对你相对温和的立场感到意外。

revisions.source: This is an easy way to separate yourself from Reagan.
revisions.zh: 这是一个轻松与里根拉开距离的办法。

revisions.source: Meese is under a cloud of suspicion, and it is better not to tie yourself too closely to his fortunes.
revisions.zh: 米斯正笼罩在疑云之下，最好别把自己的前途与他绑得太紧。

revisions.source: Roger Ailes produces a couple of vivid ads on this issue. The story is embarrassing enough, but Dukakis seems completely unable to respond to your attacks.
revisions.zh: 罗杰·艾尔斯围绕这个问题制作了几支生动的广告。这件事本身就够尴尬了，而杜卡基斯似乎完全不知道如何回应你的攻击。

revisions.source: On the one hand, you have taken the high road. On the other hand, crime is huge issue and you are definitely leaving it on the table.
revisions.zh: 一方面，你保持了风度；另一方面，犯罪是个重大议题，你显然没有充分利用这个机会。

revisions.source: Dukakis does not have an elegant defense prepared for this action, and your attacks seem to really stick.
revisions.zh: 对于这个举动，杜卡基斯没有准备好得体的辩护，你的攻击似乎相当奏效。

revisions.source: Advisors feel that you are definitely leaving something on the table.
revisions.zh: 顾问认为，你显然没有把这个机会充分利用起来。

revisions.source: On yet another issue, Dukakis does not mount an effective defense or counterattack to your campaign.
revisions.zh: 又一个议题上，杜卡基斯未能对你的竞选攻势作出有效辩护或反击。

revisions.source: Unfortunately, the word “bestiality” is making some voters question the ugliness of this campaign. Advisors agree that you should pump the brakes on your attacks for the time being.
revisions.zh: 遗憾的是，“兽交”一词让一些选民开始质疑这场竞选的丑陋程度。顾问一致认为，你应该暂时收敛攻击。

revisions.source: Even Lee Atwater thinks that this attack would be a bridge too far.
revisions.zh: 就连李·阿特沃特都觉得，这种攻击未免太过分。

revisions.source: Best to lie low on the Iran-Contra issue and hope that Dukakis doesn't bring it up too much.
revisions.zh: 最好在伊朗门问题上保持低调，希望杜卡基斯不要过多提起它。

revisions.source: It's extremely important that you do not appear to be implicated in this scandal. And if you did hear a stray word or two, you could count on Reagan's team in any case.
revisions.zh: 绝不能让你看上去牵涉这桩丑闻，这至关重要。即便你偶然听到过一两句话，反正还有里根的团队可以依靠。

revisions.source: There's not much you can add to the Beltway flap du jour.
revisions.zh: 对于华盛顿政坛今天又闹出的这场风波，你也没什么可补充的。

revisions.source: Things went great for a few days, until Mr. Quayle laid down a whopper of a gaffe during a speech in Michigan, which was immediately picked up by the national news.
revisions.zh: 头几天一切都很好，直到奎尔先生在密歇根州的一次演说中闹出了一个惊人的口误，立刻被全国媒体报道。

revisions.source: This is probably your best course for the time being.
revisions.zh: 眼下这大概是你最好的做法。

revisions.source: Everybody knows that Dan Quayle lost, but decorum requires you to spin it otherwise.
revisions.zh: 大家都知道丹·奎尔输了，但出于礼仪，你得换一种说法来圆场。

revisions.source: The potential upside of this message is complicated by the controversy over Dan Quayle's National Guard service.
revisions.zh: 丹·奎尔在国民警卫队服役的争议，使这番宣传可能带来的好处变得复杂了。

revisions.source: As capital punishment becomes an issue, it's difficult to find a position that doesn't alienate some group of your potential voters.
revisions.zh: 随着死刑成为议题，很难找到一种不会疏远某些潜在选民群体的立场。

revisions.source: Your new position is a bombshell, and its greatly unappealing to most Republicans.
revisions.zh: 你的新立场像一颗重磅炸弹，对大多数共和党人来说极其不讨喜。

revisions.source: Unfortunately, this position alienates you with moderates in the current high-crime environment.
revisions.zh: 在当前犯罪高发的环境中，这一立场会让温和派疏远你。

revisions.source: Even some solid Republicans are questioning the wisdom of more tax cuts with the current debt and deficit.
revisions.zh: 考虑到当前的债务和赤字，就连一些坚定的共和党人也在质疑进一步减税是否明智。

revisions.source: More tax cuts are not part of the Democratic Party orthodoxy at this point.
revisions.zh: 进一步减税，目前并不符合民主党的主流政策立场。

revisions.source: This statement brings cheers from all corners of the party.
revisions.zh: 这番话赢得了党内各方的欢呼。
